transcript.text: Shila was a travel nurse at Montana State Hospital.
This was one of the hospitals she traveled to and mostly worked night shifts.
One night her floor was slow so she got pulled down to the ECU to work.
That night one of her patients rang the call bell three o'clock in the morning.
What does she want?
What do you mean?
The nurse that keeps coming in here and standing there in the corner.
Who's Daisy but she's sitting at the nurse station?
Know the other one.
Well, there's no other one. It's just us two.
Okay, if she does it again, just ring the bell and I'll come right in, okay?
Mary's acting really weird. Complaining about some nurse keeps coming in her room.
She must be dreaming or something.
Hello?
Hello?
See, there's no one else here. You must be dreaming.
No, she went in the bathroom.
There's nobody in the bathroom.
What does she look like?
It's too dark to tell. I can tell it's a woman but it's so dark I can't really make her face out.
I want to use the bathroom. Are you sure she's not in there?
There's no one in here. Trust me.
Listen, don't worry about it.
I will be right there at the station. Just call my name if you need anything. I'll come right away, okay?
After a few hours, when Sheila went back to the patient's room to check on her,
she was shocked to find Mary lying dead on the bathroom floor.
Three months after the incident, Sheila got pulled back down to the same unit.
She had the same room as before.
This time a man in his early 60s was the patient. He was a nice guy, very alert and oriented.
The night was quiet. It was about 3am and our patients called light went off again.
You're my nurse, right?
Yeah?
Don't wait as this woman keeps coming in here and standing in the corner. What does she want?
What?
Honestly, I don't know, sir. It's just as two nurses here tonight on this floor and you're not the first one to say that.
Stay, see my heart is pounding. Remember that incident that happened with patient Mary in room number four?
Mr. Howard saw the same woman.
This is creepy as hell.
Don't you know about that incident? What incident?
There was a nurse who worked here in the 1990s. She was extremely overworked and stressed and could not handle it anymore.
And one night she was found dead on the bathroom floor. Several patients have reported seeing that nurse in the hospital.
Maybe it's the ghost of that nurse.
Oh, shut up. Don't try to scare me.
Hi, everyone. I hope you enjoyed the story. Don't forget to comment and subscribe to my channel if you haven't already.
I'll see you again with another creepy story. Until then, bye!
